# Private tool inventory template

Copy into .local/notes/tools.md. These fields are notes, not parser settings. Keep actual paths private; collect only useful capabilities.

| Role | Tool/version | Private executable path | Verification method/date | Status and limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Emulator | Example emulator, version checked locally | ../toolkit/emulators/example.exe | Version dialog; record date privately | Unknown until checked |
| Debugger | Available/absent/unknown | Fill privately | Verify breakpoint and memory domains | Record configuration, not assumed support |
| Assembler/compiler | Fill installed version | Fill privately | Local version command | No automatic download |
| Graphics utility | Fill if available | Fill privately | Verify format/bit depth support | No credentials |

Also record Python/Git versions, command conventions and useful optional utilities. Hardware capabilities and testing procedures belong in the testing note. A path is not authorization to install, update or run an interactive tool.
